hints.title: Compare with Target Order
hints.text: The expected order is simply the array sorted in non-decreasing order. Compare the given heights array with the sorted version.

hints.title: Sorting Duplicate Copy
hints.text: Create a copy of heights and sort it to produce expected. Indices where heights and expected differ represent out-of-order students.

hints.title: Mismatch Count
hints.text: Iterate across all indices from 0 to n - 1. Increment a counter for every index where heights[i] is not equal to expected[i].

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of students in heights array
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating without reference sorted order requires re-implementing order checks.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Creating a sorted copy takes O(N log N) time and O(N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should produce the sorted copy and count index-wise mismatches.
complexity.notes: Can also be solved in O(N) using counting sort since height values <= 100.
